results.fact: Where to leave the maintained trail after Hannegan Pass

results.evidence: A published Challenger approach says a good trail goes to Hannegan Pass, then down to the Chilliwack River crossing (~2,750 ft) 9 miles from the car before climbing onto Easy Ridge; another trip report walked about two miles past Copper Creek camp to a hidden path by a cairn and crossed the river to the Easy Ridge trail; a third crossed the river on a log to reach it. None leave the trail at the pass.

From here it is sustained cross-country travel:
